Header.Name: lexicalProfileRev1
Header.Description: Profile for decribing lexical resources. Rev1: lexicalConceptualResourceInfo replaced with a revised version lexicalConceptualResourceInfoRev1

Element.name: resourceType
Element.Documentation: Indicates the type of the resource

item.AppInfo: for individual information objects of any medium
for text, speech, image, video, multimodal/multimedia corpora, corpora with sensorimotor (numerical) information, n-gram resources. Raw or annotated content, e.g. treebanks
includes lexica, ontologies, dictionaries, word lists etc.
used for tools, systems, system components etc.
covers grammars etc.

Element.name: resourceName
Element.Documentation: The full name by which the resource is known; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: description
Element.Documentation: Provides the description of the resource in prose

Element.name: resourceShortName
Element.Documentation: The short form (abbreviation, acronym etc.) used to identify the resource; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: url
Element.Documentation: A URL used as homepage of an entity (e.g. of a person, organization, resource etc.) and/or where an entity (e.g. LR, document etc.) is located

Element.name: PID
Element.Documentation: A globally unique, persistent identifier for the resource

Element.name: identifier
Element.Documentation: An identifier, unique within some scope, not necessarily globally unique.

Element.name: availabilityStartDate
Element.Documentation: Specifies the start date of availability of a resource - only for cases where a resource is available for a restricted time period.

Element.name: availabilityEndDate
Element.Documentation: Specifies the end date of availability of a resource - only for cases where a resource is available for a restricted time period.

Element.name: userCategory
Element.Documentation: Provides the framework for describing the conditions imposed by the nature of the user (for instance, a research use may have different implications depending on this)

item.AppInfo: Users in academic institutions
Any person
Users specifically authorized for using the resource

Element.name: distributionAccessMedium
Element.Documentation: Specifies the medium (channel) used for delivery or providing access to the resource

Element.name: downloadLocation
Element.Documentation: Any URL where the resource can be downloaded from

Element.name: executionLocation
Element.Documentation: Any URL where the web service providing access to the resource being described and/or the web service that is being described can be executed

Element.name: fee
Element.Documentation: Specifies the costs that are required to access the resource, a fragment of the resource or to use a tool or service

Element.name: attributionText
Element.Documentation: The text that must be quoted for attribution purposes when using a resource - for cases where a resource is provided with a restriction on attribution

enumeration.item: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD)
Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)

Element.name: conditionsOfUse
Element.Documentation: Corresponds to the META-SHARE "restrictionsOfUse". Changed the name because some of its values are not actually *restrictions* (e.g. "commercial use")

item.AppInfo: other conditions
academic use
authentication required
inform copyright holder
only for LRT use
only META-SHARE members
no derivatives
no redistribution
authorization required
research plan required
personal data

Element.name: actorType
Element.Documentation: Designates whether the actor is a person or an orgaization. USAGE: If value is *person*, use personInfo for detailed info. If value is *organization*, use organizatioInfo.

Element.name: role
Element.Documentation: The role or function an actor has within the context indicated by the parent component of actorInfo (e.g. contact, creator, validator, etc). Example: A resource may be assigned multiple contacts, each with their separate roles/functions, e.g. one for answering technical questions and another for any other issues.
